Comments: NRB birth registration guidance includes processes and fees for "Foreigners" (MK30,000) and special cases for adopted children requiring Resident Foreigner ID, evidencing non-citizens can be registered for vital events; no clear exclusion indicated, so treated as all included.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.

The Malawi Refugee Law Reader states refugees and asylum seekers are legally excluded from the National Registration Act, so there is no statutory right to register their births; in practice, ad hoc arrangements exist so that refugee children born at Dzaleka camp are given birth certificates (per a 2021 UN Malawi report cited in the same source). This matches "Some refugees and IDPs" (3) rather than "All included" (4); a fee schedule for "foreigners" does not establish a legal right for asylum seekers/refugees specifically.
